description: Source script for seeding a PostgreSQL database with role, competency, adjacency, mapping, user, plan, and goal data. Supports json file loading, fallback minimal dataset, and endpoint verification.

methods.name: Optional[List[Dict[str,Any]]] _load_json_list(name: str)
methods.description: Loads a JSON array from a specified data file, with fallback and validation.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_tables(db: Session)
methods.description: Creates minimal catalog tables required for seeding if they do not exist.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_roles(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert/update of role records based on unique code.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Performs idempotent insert/update of competency records based on unique code.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _translate_adjacency_codes_to_ids(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Converts adjacency data from role codes to role IDs.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _translate_mappings_codes_to_ids(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Converts role competency mappings from codes to foreign key IDs.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_competencies(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Insert or update role-competency association with required level.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_role_adjacency(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Insert or update adjacency relations between roles.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_simple_users(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Upsert demo simple user data into the database.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_plans(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Insert or update career plans based on user_id and title.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _upsert_goals(db: Session, items: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Insert or update goals associated with plans.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Dict[str,Any]]] _fallback_dataset()
methods.description: Provides a minimal hardcoded dataset for seeding fallback data.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _attach_goals_by_title(db: Session, goals_by_title: List[Dict[str, Any]])
methods.description: Resolves plan IDs from titles and attaches goals accordingly.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] seed_full()
methods.description: Main function executing the seed process, including database sync, JSON or fallback data seeding, and endpoint verification.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Entry point to execute seed_full and print summary/status.
